cues.text: 但这些美丽和我无关。我在这里已经一年多了，大多数时候只能通过打零工度日。
cues.textEn: But none of that beauty had anything to do with me. I had been here over a year, mostly scraping by on odd jobs.

cues.text: 偶尔有几件委托，但像婚外情、替小道报纸偷拍这样的三流委托，也是几个月之前的事情了。
cues.textEn: I got a case now and then. Affairs, taking pictures for scandal sheets. Even those lousy jobs were months ago.

cues.text: 除此之外，没有任何的真相需要我去发现。醒醒，是时候去挣房租了。
cues.textEn: Otherwise, there was no truth waiting for me to uncover. Wake up. Time to earn the rent.
